groups.sentence: Instructors build oral components, presentations, or verbal exams into course assignments and assessments from the start.
Instructors check in with students about their process and how they arrive at their work while it is underway.
Instructors have students present, explain, or defend their submitted work orally or in a live conversation as part of assessment.
Students are expected to be able to explain, discuss, or defend their work verbally when asked.
Instructors ask students to explain their work, reasoning, and process in a conversation or meeting when AI misuse is suspected.
Instructors may require a short in-person or supervised oral exam or redo of the work when unauthorized AI use is suspected.
Students meet with the instructor to discuss the assignment when AI use is suspected or not acknowledged.
Oral examinations and code reviews are growing practices for checking that students understand their submitted work.
